Palladio's plate already contains all the ingredients we still use today. This approach stayed the same until the computer arrived: separate views, to be kept consistent by hand.

t.Le «dimensioni» dicono quali informazion: The «dimensions» say which information is added to the model beyond geometry. Before 3D there is the two-dimensional CAD drawing (2D). Up to 5D there is agreement everywhere; from 6D the definitions change from country to country, and 8D, 9D and 10D are proposals still under discussion, not standards. That is why in a specification it is better to state which uses and which information are needed, not just a label.

t.Obbligo di usare il BIM non vuol dire ob: A mandate to use BIM does not mean a mandate to be certified. Almost everywhere certification is voluntary: it serves to show a client, through the judgement of a third party, that you can do what you claim. Here is how it works in the countries we have checked, with the rule that governs it and the source.
t.Si certificano le competenze di una figu: The skills of a role are certified, for example BIM Manager or BIM Coordinator: an exam and maintenance over the years. Bodies that certify people are accredited under ISO/IEC 17024.
t.Si certifica che uno studio o un'impresa: It is certified that a practice or a company manages information as required by ISO 19650: an audit of processes and projects, repeated every year.
t.Per le opere pubbliche oltre 30 milioni: For public works above 30 million Hong Kong dollars, the appointed party's BIM team must be led by a BIM Manager certified by the Construction Industry Council (CIC). For tenders from 1 January 2024, BIM Coordinators must also be certified (at least half at full level).

t.Il Codice dei contratti chiede alle staz: The Public Contracts Code requires contracting authorities to appoint a common data environment manager, at least one digital process manager and, for each project, an information coordinator, with «adequate competence» acquired through professional practice or courses passed successfully. Certification is not required: it is one way to document competence. The roles are those of UNI 11337-7:2018; the requirements for certifying them are in the reference practice UNI/PdR 78:2020, in force since 2 March 2020.

t.Il Plan BIM, approvato dal Consiglio dei: The Plan BIM, approved by the Council of Ministers on 27 June 2023, is mandatory for the State administration and is phased in by levels from 2024 to 2030. It does not require personal certificates: at the highest levels all contract staff must be trained according to UNE-EN ISO 19650, and a BIM manager with at least 3 years' experience in BIM contracts is required.

h.La missione del sito: far conoscere la c: The site's mission: to make BIM culture known to the whole world. The curator's personal mission: to spread it in Italy, a country deeply attached to its traditions, so that BIM is not just a «certificate» for public tenders but a tool deeply tied to the design method. We can't work miracles, but we try to do things properly. We give it a go.

h.2 Il CAD: le stesse linee, al computer: 2 CAD: the same lines, on a computer
h.Il CAD porta il tavolo da disegno nel co: CAD brings the drawing board into the computer. You still draw lines, more precise, easy to copy and correct. Each line can be given attributes: the layer, the colour, the line type, perhaps a text saying «brick wall». They are labels placed on the drawing that describe it but do not govern it. To lengthen a wall you have to move its lines, and then correct the section, the elevation and the bill of quantities by hand.
h.Prova a muovere i cursori: cambia il par: Try moving the sliders: change the parameter and the wall, the area and the volume update by themselves. Example values
h.Nel BIM non si disegnano più linee, ma o: In BIM you no longer draw lines, but three-dimensional objects: a wall, a slab, a window. Each object is governed by parameters: values such as length, height and thickness, linked to one another by formulas. The volume is not redrawn, it is calculated. What we see on screen is no longer a drawing but a representation of the data: plans, sections and schedules all come from the same model.
h.Le informazioni si estraggono e si inser: Information can be extracted and added. Quantities, areas, volumes and schedules come out of the model; and the data needed for calculations, tenders, construction and maintenance goes into it.
h.Le modifiche sono vive. Se alzi un solai: Changes are live. If you raise a slab or widen a room, plan, sections, areas, volumes and schedules update together. In CAD the same work took hours.
h.Un cambio vale per tutti. Se cambi il ma: One change applies to all. If you change the material of a wall type, all the walls of that type change, throughout the project.
h.Attributo o parametro? L'attributo è un': Attribute or parameter? An attribute is a piece of information attached to an element of the drawing, like the layer or colour of a line: it describes it but does not govern it. A parameter, on the other hand, governs the object: change the value and the shape changes, and with it everything that depends on it.

h.Il romanzo che Jack London pubblicò nel: The novel Jack London published in 1906, set in north-western Canada at the time of the Klondike gold rush. It tells the life of White Fang, a wolf-dog, seen almost always through his eyes: his birth in the wild, the law of the strongest, his passage among humans, first among the natives, then in the hands of a cruel master who makes him fight, and finally the meeting with someone who manages to tame him through trust. h.Antonia Pozzi (Milano, 1912–1938) scriss: Antonia Pozzi (Milan, 1912–1938) wrote her poems in less than ten years, without publishing them during her lifetime. The collection Parole came out after her death, in 1939, edited by her father, who altered some of the texts; it was republished in 1948 with a preface by Eugenio Montale, and the most recent editions restore the original lines. They are short, luminous poems, suspended between the mountains, nature and a wounded sensitivity. Pozzi was also a photographer: she looked at the world with the same attention with which she wrote.
h.Ci sono poesie bellissime, che mi toccan: There are beautiful poems that touch me closely. This book is tied to my years in Bari, when I was part of AggregARTI with Domenico Fornarelli: at that time everything about Antonia Pozzi left a mark on me, partly because, like us, she looked at the world through photography. And her end, so young, by her own hand, touched me personally.

And that is exactly the point, for me: going back to the temet nosce, «know thyself», which is perhaps my favourite phrase and my personal reference, together with kaizen, continuous improvement in small steps.
h.È un libro che non dovrebbe mai mancare: It is a book that anyone who really wants results should always have. Only in that state of deep concentration, almost of flow, can you really achieve everything.

h.Dario Bressanini è un chimico dell'Unive: Dario Bressanini is a chemist at the University of Insubria and one of the most followed science communicators in Italy on food. In La dieta termodinamica («The thermodynamic diet») he approaches body weight with the method of physics: the balance between the energy we take in and the energy we use, the reason why so many diets promise miracles and then fail, and what is really needed to lose weight and keep it off.
h.Giulia Enders, medico tedesco, con L'int: Giulia Enders, a German doctor, with Gut (originally Darm mit Charme, 2014) brought to the general public the organ we talk about least: how digestion works, the role of gut bacteria and the dialogue between gut and brain, told with irony and with drawings by her sister Jill.
h.Dario Bressanini è un gigante della divu: Dario Bressanini is a giant of science communication in Italy: he explains everything about nutrition in a rigorously scientific way, with the eye not of the biologist but of the chemist and physicist. La dieta termodinamica confirmed to me what dieticians and nutritionists say: the perfect diet does not exist; the principles of thermodynamics do. Then, of course, biology comes into play, which is very complex, and together with healthy habits it gives the final result: a healthy body.
h.L'intestino felice ha ormai qualche anno: Gut is a few years old now, but it still shows how important it is to know well the processes that take place inside us.

h.Il manuale di composizione del fotografo: The composition manual by the British photographer and author Michael Freeman, published in English in 2007 as The Photographer's Eye. It explains how an image is built: the frame, the graphic elements (points, lines, shapes, rhythm), light and colour, up to the photographer's intention. The rules are not recipes to apply, but tools to understand, also so as to know when to break them.

There I learned to look before shooting, which is exactly the theme of this book.
h.Con Domenico ho condiviso anche gli anni: With Domenico I also shared the years of AggregARTI, the cultural association he chaired: a group born around photography and open to every form of culture.
